title: Show HN: I told people I'm a convicted felon after 20 years of hiding it
title_zh: Show HN：隐藏了20年后，我告诉人们我曾是一名被定罪的重罪犯

paragraphs.en: Engineer, founder, dad, expat. Formerly homeless, convicted felon (pardoned). Retired at 38.
paragraphs.zh: 工程师、创始人、父亲、旅居海外者。 曾流落街头，曾是重罪犯（已获赦免）。38 岁退休。

paragraphs.en: I write science fiction as Leonard Buford.
paragraphs.zh: 我以伦纳德·布福德（Leonard Buford）为笔名写科幻小说。

paragraphs.en: These days I build companies and write books for fun.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，我创办公司和写书是为了消遣。

paragraphs.en: I’ve started or joined early 17 companies since 2007. Most of them shut down.
paragraphs.zh: 自 2007 年以来，我创办或加入了 17 家早期公司。其中大多数都已关闭。

paragraphs.zh: 我是 Eventbrite 的第 3 号工程师，见证了公司从 400 万美元增长到 7 亿美元的历程。

paragraphs.zh: Nouscraft 三部曲已售出超过 10,000 册，平均评分 4.5 星。

paragraphs.en: From felony to seven figures. This book details clawing my way out of the worst mistake of my life and going to prison at nineteen years old. It also covers building billion-dollar companies. It’s written the way Chaplin put it: life, viewed up close, is a tragedy, but viewed from far away, it’s a comedy.
paragraphs.zh: 从重罪到七位数身家。 本书详述了我如何走出人生中最严重的一次错误——十九岁锒铛入狱——并一步步爬出来的过程。 本书也涵盖了打造价值十亿美元的公司。 正如卓别林所说：人生近看是悲剧，远看是喜剧——本书正是这样写就的。

paragraphs.en: A completed LitRPG trilogy about a rogue AI that traps ten billion people in a game they cannot log out of. It follows four POVs and is very Game-of-Thrones with all the backstabbing going on. Think Dungeon Crawler Carl where the MCs might actually die. Over 10,000 copies sold, averaging 4.5 stars across Amazon and Goodreads.

paragraphs.en: Putting a thing on paper (neovim) sentence by sentence, word by word, does something to your brain. It is the work of thinking , of brain exercise . If you outsource thinking and you keep the result, you slowly lose the part that made you able to produce it. I think humans have to keep doing it manually to be able to have deep thoughts at all.
paragraphs.zh: 一句一句、一个字一个字地把东西写在纸上（neovim），会对你的大脑产生某种作用。 这是思考的工作，是大脑的锻炼。 如果你把思考外包出去，只保留结果，你会慢慢失去那个让你能够产出结果的部分。 我认为人类必须继续手动去做这件事，才能拥有真正深刻的思考。

sents.en: Putting a thing on paper (neovim) sentence by sentence, word by word, does something to your brain.
sents.zh: 一句一句、一个字一个字地把东西写在纸上（neovim），会对你的大脑产生某种作用。

sents.en: It is the work of thinking , of brain exercise .
sents.zh: 这是思考的工作，是大脑的锻炼。

sents.en: If you outsource thinking and you keep the result, you slowly lose the part that made you able to produce it.
sents.zh: 如果你把思考外包出去，只保留结果，你会慢慢失去那个让你能够产出结果的部分。

sents.en: I think humans have to keep doing it manually to be able to have deep thoughts at all.
sents.zh: 我认为人类必须继续手动去做这件事，才能拥有真正深刻的思考。

paragraphs.en: That said, coding is different, and I use AI for most of it. I spent twenty-five years writing code by hand so I feel like I've earned it. I mean sure, there's an art there when buildig out code, but I'm interested in the product and the people. I still review all the code the AI writes though. Can't trust Skynet.
paragraphs.zh: 话虽如此，写代码是另一回事，我大部分都用 AI 来完成。 我花了二十五年时间手工写代码，所以我觉得这是我应得的。 我是说，当然，构建代码确实有门道，但我更感兴趣的是产品和人。 不过我仍然会审查 AI 写的所有代码。不能信任天网。

sents.en: I still review all the code the AI writes though. Can't trust Skynet.
